title: AI-Driven 6G-Enabled V2X Communications for Smart and Sustainable Mobility
summary: AI4Africa proposes an AI-enabled 6G-V2X communication framework for connected vehicles; the team reports that the work remains in training and simulation, with no results.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: In June 2025 AI4Africa proposed an AI-enabled 6G vehicle-to-everything (V2X) network for connected transport. The team reported that the work was in the model training and simulation phase and that it had produced no results. Its deep reinforcement learning method allocates vehicles to roadside units. The team takes integer linear programming in its conventional use as the benchmark for that method. The system has not been deployed. No paper, code release or ITU update on this system has appeared since June 2025. Mobility benefits remain prospective.

data.answer:
AI4Africa proposes 6G-V2X networks for connected transport. The system has no deployment, and mobility benefits remain prospective.

The undeployed design provides no observed reduction in congestion, collisions, or emissions. Network reliability, vehicle compatibility, and the added benefit of AI over existing control require evaluation.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
